title: Color across architectural planes
slide_intent: Use light to distinguish adjacent surfaces because spatial color can direct attention and create atmosphere without adding text.
strategic_value: Spotify can turn a circulation edge into part of the event identity through magenta and blue light.
demonstration: A cropped architectural corner contrasts a magenta opening with a deep-blue plane and bright base lighting.
practical_value: Compare color separation at an edge before applying a palette to an entire room.
